reviews.comment: The best professor I've had at my time here at A&M. Engaging and interesting lectures, and class topics are interesting and challenging at the same time. Some of the coolest experiences I've had in college was in her class.

Reliability was very difficult, especially if you've never touched probabilistic distributions before, but she's a very great, practical, and fair teacher. I'd take any class she teaches because of this, and her stories as an astronaut are very entertaining in class. She's very passionate, and it shows!

Absolutely amazing professor! She teaches very comprehensively and in a way that's applicable to real life. Every time she tells one of her stories from being a NASA astronaut or military pilot, everyone in the class is locked in. She's very fair and gives reasonable assignments with enough time. She teaches very well as well.

She gives very good lectures and has activities built in to give you practice. Hw is reasonable and very relevant to exams. Exams are open everything and are designed to give you real world practice. A project that is supposed to represent real world project you could have. Overall very good class, and very good material. Would highly recommend
Very knowledgeable. Good lectures and good experience to share. However, get ready to work. This is not a blowoff class. Homeworks are not easy and are graded somewhat harshly.

Attendance is graded & she offers a TON of extra credit opportunities simply by going to class. All tests are open-everything, and she will regrade work-out problems for half credit back. Class & lectures are really well organized. Content is a bit more challenging than expected for an elective, but she is a great professor! Definitely recommend!

Dr. Currie-Gregg has been my favorite professor so far. She has incredible stories about her experience and tends to encourage class interaction and actually learning material. All tests were open-note and you could do corrections for half credit back. I would 100% recommend her for any class.

If you have the chance to take any class by Dr. Currie-Gregg, I would highly recommend that you do. Her class is very well organized and straight-forward. The good news - if you show up to class and pay attention, her lectures are great and she definitely tests what she teaches. Homework wasn't too bad, but there was a sizeable group project.

Dr. Currie-Gregg is a very intelligent professor, and she is fascinating to listen to. Her classes definitely are not blow-off classes, though, so there is a lot of work involved (including a lengthy group assignment). However, her tests are fair and she allows corrections for half of your credit back. Overall, I really enjoyed her as a professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.
